description: This file defines the CustomerOption entity class used for modeling customer options within the sales management system. It includes fields for option metadata, relationships to descriptions and merchant store, and Hibernate/JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: CustomerOption
classes.description: Entity class representing a customer option, including fields for identification, categorization, description links, and relationships to merchant stores.

methods.name: CustomerOption
methods.description: Default constructor for CustomerOption class.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the set of CustomerOptionDescription objects associated with this customer option.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the set of CustomerOptionDescription objects for this customer option.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the primary key identifier of the CustomerOption.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the primary key identifier for the CustomerOption.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the MerchantStore associated with this customer option.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a MerchantStore with this customer option.

methods.name: setDescriptionsList
methods.description: Sets the list form of descriptions.

methods.name: getDescriptionsList
methods.description: Returns the list form of descriptions.

methods.name: getDescriptionsSettoList
methods.description: Converts and returns the set of descriptions as a list, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: getCustomerOptionType
methods.description: Returns the type of customer option.

methods.name: setCustomerOptionType
methods.description: Sets the type of customer option.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code of the customer option.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code for the customer option.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the customer option is active.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets the active status of the customer option.

methods.name: isPublicOption
methods.description: Checks if the customer option is public.

methods.name: setPublicOption
methods.description: Sets the public visibility of the customer option.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order for display purposes.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the sort order of the customer option.
